meta.title: Heat Flux Density Converter — Convert Watt/m² and More
meta.description: Free heat flux density converter for 4+ units including Watt/m², Kilowatt/m², cal/(s·cm²). Instant, accurate, browser-based.

content.intro: W/m², BTU/(h·ft²). Convert between 4 heat flux density units instantly, with engineering-grade precision and no signup required.
content.result_section: Pick any two units below to convert between them. The base unit for heat flux density in this tool is **Wm2**; every conversion routes through it for consistency.
content.formula_section: Most heat flux density conversions are a single multiplication by a fixed factor. Temperature is the notable exception — it uses additive offsets, not just multiplication. The converter handles both transparently.

content.use_cases:
- Cooking, baking, and oven temperature checks across recipes.
- Weather and climate comparisons across regions.
- HVAC sizing, where loads are quoted in BTU, kW, or tons.
- Lab work and material processing temperature setpoints.
- Industrial process control in mixed-unit environments.
content.tips:
Bookmark the conversions you use most — each pair has its own dedicated page with formulas, a lookup table, and FAQs.

When working with derived units (area, volume), remember the factor scales with the dimension: a length factor f becomes f² for area and f³ for volume.
content.faq:

**Q:** Is it free?
**A:** Yes — completely free, no signup, no limits.

**Q:** Which units are supported?
**A:** Watt/m² (W/m²), Kilowatt/m² (kW/m²), cal/(s·cm²) (cal/(s·cm²)), BTU/(h·ft²) (BTU/(h·ft²)).
